author: dilpickel
body:
Hello dilpickel here and welcome to my video hub!

In here you can see what I have published to YouTube.
My channel is mostly Minecraft parkour but other stuff pops in all the time.
Subscribe if you like what you see.

replies.author: dilpickel
replies.body:
Wow this was a hard one dang you tanpika :P.
The jumps them self weren't to hard but the length of the parkour and the way it was setup made it one of the hardest maps I've played. Not being able to practice those harder jumps at the end were killing me.
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dlB2S9pE0Wk&feature=youtu.be
